newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - San Francisco water, sewer.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - San Francisco water, sewer.

text.p: The City and County of San Francisco
San Francisco Water Revenue Bonds, 1996 Series A
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Public Utilities
Commission of the City and County of San Francisco (the Commission''), in San Francisco, State of California, intends to offer for public sale on

at the hour of 10:00 a.m. local time at the offices of Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP, 400 Sansome Street, Second Floor, Conference Room E, San Francisco, California 94111, not to exceed $145,000,000 principal amount of water revenue bonds of the Commission designated Public
Utilities Commission of the City and County of San

Francisco, San Francisco Water Revenue Bonds, 1996 Series A (the Bonds''). The Commission reserves the right to postpone or cancel the sale upon notice given through Munifacts News Service not less than 24 hours prior to the time the bids are to be received. If the purchase of the Bonds is not awarded on Tuesday, December 3, 1996, the Commission intends to again offer the Bonds for public sale at the above time and place on one of the following days: December 4, December 5, December 10, December 11, December 12, December 17, December 18 or December 19, as the Commission shall determine. Notice of the new date for the receipt of bids will be confirmed through Munifacts News Service not less than 24 hours prior to the time the bids

are to be received. Such sale date may be further postponed to one of the specified days as provided above. As an accommodation to bidders, telephonic or telecopied notice of the postponement of the sale date and the new sale date will be given to any bidder upon request to the Co-Financial Advisors to the Commission identified herein. Failure of any bidder to receive such Munifacts News Service, telephonic or telecopied notice shall not affect the legality of the sale. NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Bonds will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale, and copies of the Official Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds will be furnished upon request mailed to Artemis Capital Group, Inc., 505 Montgomery Street, Suite 820, San Francisco, California 94111, Attention:Mr. P. Scott Nagelson, telephone (415) 982-5804, or Charles A. Bell Securities Corp., 44 Montgomery Street, Suite 960, San Francisco, California 94104, Attention:Mr. Chris St. James, (415) 433-0270, Co-Financial Advisors to the Commission. Dated:November 15, 1996
City and County of San Francisco
